scenes.title_en: She Looked at You First, Then the Counter

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 原来你长这样。她形容得一点都不准。
lines.en: So this is what you look like. She described you completely wrong.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 想听她怎么说的？不告诉你。说了你要得意。
lines.en: Want to hear what she said? Not telling. You'd get smug.

blocks.label_zh: 主动按实际价值收购：追加

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 东西是真要卖。也想看看，送上门的便宜你占不占。
lines.en: The goods really are for sale. I also wanted to see whether you'd take a bargain that walked in the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 试完了。这事你别告诉她，她肯定骂我多事。
lines.en: Done. Don't tell her about this. She'd definitely call me a busybody.

blocks.label_en: After the Trade, Before She Leaves: Added

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她以前出门穿哪条裙子都要先问我。现在连我替她找的工作都不要。
lines.en: She used to ask me which dress to wear before going out. Now she won't even take the job I found her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……算了，这话我自己去跟她说。
lines.en: ...Never mind. I'll tell her that myself.

scenes.title_en: Don't Believe Everything That Mouth Says

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她镯子盒上的花纹，我在上层货单上见过。
lines.en: I've seen that pattern on her bracelet box in upper-district catalogs.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那是她家的。上层区卖日用品、香水、布料的几家里，就有他们。
lines.en: It's her family's. They're one of the upper-district houses selling household goods, perfume and fabric.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她从小买东西，店员先问她喜不喜欢。到你这儿，她想看看没人捧着的时候会怎么样。
lines.en: When she was little, shop assistants asked whether she liked something before she even looked at the price. Here, she wanted to see what happens when no one flatters her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她家卖香水和床单，管不了法院。她能做的，就是隔三差五跑下来看我。上面那些朋友，也就剩她一个。
lines.en: Her family sells perfume and bedding. They can't influence the courts. All she can do is come down every few days to see me. Of all her friends upstairs, she's the only one left.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 关心是关心。就是总想替我把路都挑好。
lines.en: She cares. She just always wants to pick the whole road for me.

scenes.title_en: I Can Give You a Hand

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不拿东西考你了。我是来道谢的。
lines.en: No tests today. I came to say thanks.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她母亲回来以后，她终于肯好好睡一觉。前天我去找她，她居然睡到了中午。
lines.en: After her mother came back, she finally let herself sleep. When I went to see her the day before yesterday, she'd slept until noon.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前我劝她回上面找熟人把事情摆平。她不听，我还跟她生过气。
lines.en: I used to tell her to go upstairs and ask old connections to fix it. She wouldn't listen, and I got angry with her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她最难的时候，我还在跟她说哪条裙子显精神。……我根本没听懂她在说什么。
lines.en: When she was at her worst, I was still telling her which dress would look more spirited. ...I wasn't hearing a word she said.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我跟她说了。她骂了我两句，然后问我吃饭没有。算是原谅我了吧。
lines.en: I told her. She cursed me out, then asked whether I'd eaten. I suppose that means she forgave me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有件事。她现在提起你，比提起今天赚了多少还多。我猜多半是在骂你。
lines.en: One more thing. She mentions you more than she mentions today's earnings. I assume most of it is complaining.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她总不能每次见我，都承认自己想你吧。
lines.en: She can't admit she misses you every time she sees me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她要是知道我来了，非掐死我不可。所以我就直说了——你要是真喜欢她，我可以帮你一把。
lines.en: If she knew I came here, she'd kill me. So I'll say it straight: if you really like her, I can give you a hand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 因为她是我朋友。还因为她每次跟我讲你们聊了什么，最后全是货价！我听着都替你们着急。
lines.en: Because she's my friend. And because every time she tells me what you two talked about, it ends up being about prices! I get anxious just listening.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好！第一条：她要是没急着走，你千万别问“还有什么货”。你就说——今天的发夹真好看。
lines.en: Good! Rule one: if she isn't in a hurry to leave, whatever you do, don't ask 'What else do you have?' Just say—your hair clip looks nice today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 没戴发夹就夸别的！重点不是发夹。你得看着她，别光看柜台。
lines.en: If she's not wearing a hairpin, compliment something else! The hairpin isn't the point. Look at her, not just the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也就准备了这么几句。都很好用！别笑，用上了再来谢我。
lines.en: That's all I've prepared. They all work! Don't laugh. Thank me after you use them.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行，我不管了。……不过她要是问起，我就说你今天总算说了句像样的话。
lines.en: Fine, I'll stay out of it. ...But if she asks, I'll say you finally said something decent today.

choices.label_zh: 进入埃莉诺与莉迪亚的后宫剧情。
choices.label_en: Enter Eleanor and Lydia’s harem story.
choices.description_zh: 保留原恋爱资格；上层区声望50／100／150依次推进，获得三件橱窗饰品。不扣声望，未达标可继续经营与日常。
choices.description_en: Original romance requirements apply. Progress at 50/100/150 Upper Level reputation and earn three showcase ornaments. No reputation is spent; keep trading and receiving visits while waiting.

choices.label_zh: 她的事，我想自己跟她说。
choices.label_en: I want to tell her how I feel myself.
choices.description_zh: 继续原普通恋爱线，不进入本扩展。拒绝不扣好感。
choices.description_en: Continue the original ordinary romance route; this expansion does not begin. Refusal does not lower affection.

scenes.title_en: The Goods Are Settled, But She Hasn't Left

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天就到这里吧。
lines.en: That will do for today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚来过了，是吧？她教你的？
lines.en: Lydia came by, didn't she? Did she teach you that?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 教了几句。不过留你多坐一会儿，是我自己想的。你今天……气色不错。
lines.en: A few lines. But asking you to stay longer was my own idea. You look... well today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我昨晚只睡了三个钟头。
lines.en: I slept three hours last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她可真是什么都敢教！……这还差不多。
lines.en: She really will teach you anything! ...That's more like it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我妈嫌我把东西摆得太整齐，她反倒找不着，干脆把我赶出门，让我找点自己的事干。
lines.en: My mother complains I put everything away too neatly and now she can't find anything. She shooed me out and told me to find something of my own to do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 来卖货！……顺便坐一会儿。
lines.en: To sell goods! ...And to sit for a while.

blocks.label_en: If the Plaque Is in the Showcase

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那块牌子……她连这个都给你了？她碰上喜欢的店，能夸上半天，可真把自己名字摆出去的没几回。
lines.en: That plaque... she gave you that too? She can praise a shop she likes for ages, but she rarely puts her own name out there.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说要帮你介绍客人。要谢你自己去谢，别什么话都从我这儿绕一圈。
lines.en: She said she'd help you bring in customers. If you want to thank her, do it yourself. Don't route everything through me.

blocks.label_en: If Not Displayed or Not Collected

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说想帮你介绍客人。她一热心就容易跑在前头。
lines.en: She said she wants to help you find customers. When she gets enthusiastic, she runs ahead.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你能做到哪一步，跟她说清楚就行。
lines.en: Just tell her clearly how far you can go.

scenes.title_zh: 教别人的人，自己没吃饭
scenes.title_en: The One Giving Advice Hasn't Eaten

blocks.label_zh: 共同转入她的个人咨询
blocks.label_en: Together: Turning to Her Own Question

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不问她了。我自己有件东西拿不准。
lines.en: I'm not asking about her today. I have something of my own I can't decide on.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我看上一枚旧胸针。店主说是名人戴过的，可我就是觉得那几片花瓣好看。多出来的价钱，值吗？
lines.en: I saw an old brooch. The dealer says a famous person wore it, but I just like the petals. Is the extra price worth it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还在店里，我没付钱。你别笑我买东西只看好不好看。
lines.en: It's still in the shop. I haven't paid. Don't laugh at me for buying things just because they look good.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好看就是理由。谁戴过，让他拿凭据；喜欢花瓣，就按花瓣的价谈。
lines.en: Looking good is a reason. If someone famous wore it, make them show proof. If you like the petals, negotiate the price of the petals.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以不是我不懂欣赏，是我不用连那个故事一起买单？
lines.en: So it's not that I don't know how to appreciate it—it's that I don't have to pay for the story too?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还以为你会说，这种东西买来有什么用。
lines.en: I thought you'd say this kind of thing is useless.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先吃点正经的。待会儿一块甜点不算午饭。
lines.en: Eat something proper first. A piece of cake later doesn't count as lunch.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我是来教你怎么关心她的，你倒先拿我练上了。好吧，这句我就不转告她了。
lines.en: ...I came to teach you how to care about her, and you practiced on me first. Fine, I won't pass that part on.

scenes.title_en: This Line Doesn't Need Her Teaching

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最近谁见了我都问，接下来打算怎么办。
lines.en: Everyone I see lately asks what I'm going to do next.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把日子过好。找份正经工作，照顾母亲。……有时候，也想来这儿。别让我把每个字都说明白！
lines.en: Live a good life. Find proper work, look after Mother. ...And sometimes, I want to come here. Don't make me spell out every word!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我喜欢你。不想只当你有事才来找的老板。以后也不让你猜。
lines.en: I like you. I don't want to be just the shopkeeper you come to when something's wrong. I won't make you guess anymore.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这句也是她教的？
lines.en: ...Did she teach you that too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她只教我把话说清楚。喜欢谁，用不着她教。
lines.en: She only taught me to say it clearly. Who I like doesn't need her teaching.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我也是。喜欢你！听清楚了没有？
lines.en: ...Me too. I like you! Did you hear me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我手上还有灰。
lines.en: There's still dust on my hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那松开？
lines.en: Should I let go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁让你松了。
lines.en: Who told you to let go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……知道了。
lines.en: ...I understand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以后生意照做。别因为话说开了，看见我就躲。
lines.en: We'll keep doing business. Don't start avoiding me just because we've had this talk.

choices.label_zh: （说清楚）我很在乎你，但我们还是做朋友吧。
choices.label_en: (Be clear) I care about you, but let's stay friends.

scenes.title_zh: 三个人的饭，两个人慢慢吃
scenes.title_en: A Meal for Three, Eaten Slowly by Two

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我订了个位置，三个人的。她最近忙得饭都顾不上吃，正好拉她出来。我当然也去——不然你们俩大眼瞪小眼，谁找话说？
lines.en: I booked a table for three. She's been too busy to eat lately, so I'm dragging her out. Of course I'm coming too—otherwise you two would stare at each other and who'd start the conversation?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这面包是哪位师傅做的？不是我熟悉的那位，我可不买。
lines.en: Which baker made this bread? It's not the one I know, so I'm not buying it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再学一遍，刚才他没听见。
lines.en: Do it again. He missed it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，我还约了人看衣服！你们慢慢吃，不用送。
lines.en: Oh! I promised to look at clothes with someone. Take your time—no need to see me out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你刚才不是说，那家店今天早关门？
lines.en: Did you not just say that shop was closing early today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……还有另一家！总之你们慢慢吃！
lines.en: ...There is another one! Just enjoy yourselves!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 披肩！你又忘了。
lines.en: Your shawl! You forgot it again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 别又光聊货。
lines.en: Do not spend the whole time talking about stock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她真以为我看不出来。……你那杯往这边放放，摆那儿碍事。
lines.en: She really thinks I can't tell. ...Move your cup this way. It's in the way there.

scenes.title_en: She Made It Happen

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们那天后来没光聊货吧。我费心腾地方，可不是让你们拿我找乐子的。
lines.en: You two didn't spend the whole time talking about goods afterward, did you? I went to trouble to clear the space. I wasn't doing it for your entertainment.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我这算帮成了。以后她再来跟我抱怨你，我能少听一半就行。
lines.en: I'd say I helped. Next time she complains about you, I only need to hear half of it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她那天还把披肩递给我。……她一向记得这些。
lines.en: She even handed me my shawl that day. ...She always remembers things like that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回那枚胸针，我买了！他拿不出名人凭据，我就按东西本身谈，便宜了不少。配了两条裙子，都好看。
lines.en: I bought that brooch last time! He couldn't prove anyone famous wore it, so I negotiated on the piece itself and got a good discount. It goes with two of my dresses. Both look good.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 也不是听你一说就不喜欢了……就是喜欢的时候，不用再担心又当冤大头。
lines.en: It's not that I stopped liking it because of what you said... it's that I can like something without worrying I'm being fleeced.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后我自己的事，也能来问你吧？下回我带自己的难题来，你别嫌烦！
lines.en: From now on, I can ask you about my own things too, right? Next time I'll bring my own problems. Don't get annoyed!

scenes.title_en: She Goes Back, and She Comes Back Too

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚帮我打听到一家商行，收日用品和种植设备，缺个整理到货记录、点货的人。
lines.en: Lydia found me a trading house that handles household goods and growing equipment. They need someone to organize delivery records and check stock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 试了两天。头一天只让我照着单子点货。后来我挑出一箱型号写错了，他们才肯让我自己记账。
lines.en: I tried it for two days. The first day they only let me count against the list. Then I caught a crate with the wrong model number, and they let me keep the books myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 留下了！雇主在给我办工作通行。先两头跑，熟了再在上面找住处。
lines.en: They did! My employer is arranging a work pass for me. I'll run between both levels for now, and once I know the place better, I'll find a room upstairs.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲留在下面，接着干现在的活。她身上的限制还在。我有了工作，不等于她的事也了结了。
lines.en: Mother stays below, doing the work she has now. Her restrictions are still there. My having a job doesn't mean her case is closed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 研究那边让我去整理交接记录，有些得在上面做，工作通行单独办。
lines.en: The research office asked me to organize handover records. Some of it has to be done upstairs, with a separate work pass.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想去。不懂的还多，先把会的做好。莉迪亚帮我问了一间能短住的房间，离那儿不远。
lines.en: I want to go. There's still a lot I don't understand, so I'll do what I can first. Lydia asked about a room I can stay in short-term, not far from there.

blocks.label_en: If the Mother's Case Is Not Withdrawn

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的复核还没完。她照现在的登记过日子，不会因为我拿到通行，就突然搬上去。
lines.en: Mother's review isn't finished. She lives under her current registration. My getting a pass doesn't mean she'll suddenly move upstairs.

blocks.label_en: If the Mother's Case Is Withdrawn

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的正式结果也下来了。研究和住处的事，她自己拿主意。我先把我的工作做好。
lines.en: My mother's official result came through too. She'll decide about the research and where to live herself. I'll focus on doing my job well first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正这回上去，不是回去当那个什么都不用管的大小姐。
lines.en: Either way, this time going up doesn't mean going back to being the young lady who doesn't have to worry about anything.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那我可得盼着你下班了。时间提前留出来，你留，我也留。
lines.en: Then I'll have to look forward to you getting off work. Set the time aside in advance. You make time, and so do I.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你怎么不问，我以后还来不来？
lines.en: ...Why have you not asked whether I will still come?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我正想约你。
lines.en: I was about to ask you out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……会来。只是不能每回一想起你，就拎着货跑下来。
lines.en: ...I will. I just cannot run down here with a bag of stock every time I think of you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚还叫我慢慢说，省得你以为我要走了。
lines.en: Lydia even told me to say it slowly, so you wouldn't think I was leaving.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她是不是把我们俩想得太不会说话了？
lines.en: Does she think we're that bad at talking to each other?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……有时候也没想错。
lines.en: ...Sometimes she's not wrong.

scenes.title_en: No Messages From Her Today

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我来借你这儿歇歇脚！替首饰店重摆了一上午展柜，腿都站酸了。
lines.en: I'm borrowing your place to rest my feet! I spent all morning rearranging a jewelry shop's display. My legs are sore.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 头一回把最亮的全挤在一起，站远一看什么都看不清。后来留了点空，连最不起眼的那枚都有人问。老板还想让我下回接着摆。
lines.en: The first time, I packed all the brightest pieces together. From a distance you couldn't see anything. Then I left some space, and even the plainest piece got questions. The owner wants me to do it again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你看这边，花瓣的颜色还不一样。
lines.en: Look here. The petals aren't even the same color.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 很衬你。
lines.en: It suits you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……这句比夸我会摆柜子好多了。
lines.en: ...That's much better than praising my display arranging.

scenes.title_en: The Line She Taught Herself

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 下回你跟她见面，别老问工作顺不顺。她有时候也想让你注意到她新换的发饰。
lines.en: Next time you see her, don't keep asking whether work's going well. Sometimes she wants you to notice her new hair ornament.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你今天也换了。你教的，看人别光看柜台——这招有用。
lines.en: You changed yours too. You taught me to look at the person, not just the counter. It works.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你、你怎么看得这么仔细？我是让你看她！
lines.en: ...You—why are you looking so closely? I told you to look at her!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……谢谢。
lines.en: ...Thank you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那是我送她的！你这眼力，到底是好还是不好？
lines.en: ...I gave her that one! Is your eye for detail good or bad?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不赶。本来想去看新到的裙子，走到半路，又绕到这儿来了。
lines.en: No rush. I meant to go see the new dresses, but halfway there I came around to this place instead.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 裙子又不会长腿跑掉。今天先来看看你有没有学会夸人——看来学得不错。
lines.en: The dresses will not run away. Today I came to see whether you had learned to give a compliment—and it seems you have.

choices.description_zh: 只改变这次回应，不改变后续关系进程。关系要等三个人各自把话说清楚。
choices.description_en: Changes only this response, not the relationship progression. All three still need to speak for themselves.

choices.label_zh: 埃莉诺好像也有一枚差不多的。
choices.label_en: I think Eleanor has one just like it.
choices.description_zh: 只改变这次回应，不改变后续关系进程。关系要等三个人各自把话说清楚。
choices.description_en: Changes only this response, not the relationship progression. All three still need to speak for themselves.

scenes.title_en: Time Set Aside

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下周有两天，我能早点下来。我写下来了。
lines.en: There are two days next week when I can come down early. I wrote them down.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面事情一多，谁都说“就耽误你一会儿”。我不提前留出来，自己的事就总得往后放。
lines.en: When things get busy upstairs, everyone says 'this will only take a moment.' If I don't set time aside in advance, my own plans always get pushed back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那两天，算我们的事。你也记着。
lines.en: Those two days are ours. Remember that.

scenes.title_en: She's Suddenly Very Busy

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚最近来过吗？
lines.en: Has Lydia been by lately?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 前几天来过。后来就没再来。
lines.en: She came a few days ago. Then she stopped.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟我说忙。我提起她一直想去的新店，她连在哪儿都没问，就说约了别人。
lines.en: She says she's busy. I mentioned that new shop she's been wanting to visit. She didn't even ask where it was. Just said she'd made other plans.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她真不想出门时，会嫌鞋磨脚、嫌裙子不合身。不会连地方都没听清就说没空。
lines.en: When she really doesn't want to go out, she complains her shoes pinch or her dress doesn't fit. She wouldn't say she's busy without even hearing where.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在你这儿，会聊她自己的事吗？
lines.en: Does she talk about her own things when she's here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 会。
lines.en: She does.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……以前她跟我说起你，全是“他该这样”“你该那样”。最近一个字都不提了。
lines.en: ...Before, whenever she talked about you, it was all 'he should do this' and 'you should do that.' Lately she doesn't say a word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我还没想好要问她什么。你也别因为我问这一句，就突然装作不认识她。那样更难看。
lines.en: I haven't decided what to ask her yet. And don't suddenly pretend you don't know her just because I asked. That would look worse.

scenes.title_en: This Time I Really Won't Help

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后你想约她，直接问她就行。我最近……事情多。
lines.en: From now on, if you want to ask her out, just ask her. I've been... busy lately.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我们已经直接说了。
lines.en: We've already talked directly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就好。我这件事算办完了。
lines.en: Good. Then my job here is done.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又不是非得天天往这儿绕。上回为了绕过来，连想看的裙子都没去。
lines.en: It's not like I have to come around here every day. Last time I came this way, I missed a dress I wanted to see.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……后来有别的安排。
lines.en: ...I had other plans later.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不想说就算了，别拿别的事搪塞我。
lines.en: If you don't want to talk about it, fine. Don't fob me off with something else.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我以为事情办成了会很高兴。替她高兴，也替你高兴。
lines.en: I thought I'd be happy once it worked out. Happy for her, and happy for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就是……她跟我说你们见了面，我第一个想的是你们聊了什么。她没提到我，我又气自己连这个都要在意。
lines.en: It's just... when she told me you'd met, the first thing I thought about was what you talked about. She didn't mention me, and then I was angry at myself for caring.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你别安慰我。你一认真看着我，我就更说不下去了。
lines.en: Don't comfort me. When you look at me seriously, I can't finish a sentence.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 让我自己想想。今天就到这儿吧。
lines.en: Let me think on my own. That's enough for today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人的事照常。已经说好的，我都会交代清楚。
lines.en: The customer business stays as usual. Whatever's already arranged, I'll make clear.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我问的不是客人。你不来的这几天，我总忍不住看门口。
lines.en: I'm not asking about customers. These past few days you haven't come, I keep looking at the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我知道。你这么说，我就更不知道该怎么走了。
lines.en: ...I know. Hearing you say that makes it even harder to leave.

scenes.title_zh: 不再借她的名义来找你
scenes.title_en: I Won't Come in Her Name Anymore

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这回我不说路过了。我喜欢你。
lines.en: I'm not saying I was just passing by this time. I like you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一开始，我真的只是想让她过得好一点。后来她们在上面夸你，我差点又抢着说，是我先发现这家店的。
lines.en: At first I only wanted things to go better for her. Then, when they praised you upstairs, I nearly interrupted to say I had found this shop first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还记得我那枚胸针，也肯听我讲那些零碎事。我越来越盼着来，又怕你只问她怎么样了。
lines.en: You remembered my brooch, and listened to all my little stories. I kept looking forward to coming, then worrying you would only ask how she was.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可埃莉诺还不知道。你得把真话都告诉她。你到底怎么想，别让她和我都只能猜。
lines.en: But Eleanor doesn't know yet. You have to tell her the truth. Whatever you decide, don't leave us both guessing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那你去说。我一想到她会怎么看我，就一句话也想不好了。
lines.en: ...Then tell her. Every time I think of how she will look at me, I lose all my words.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真是的……这回居然轮到我等你把话说清楚。说清楚之前，别让我偷偷摸摸地等。我也会自己去找她。
lines.en: Honestly... now it's my turn to wait for you to say it clearly. Until you do, don't make me wait in secret. I'll go see her myself too.

choices.label_zh: 我也喜欢你。可我跟她在一起，不会背着她答应你什么。这件事，我会亲口告诉她。
choices.label_en: I like you too. But I'm with her, and I won't promise you anything behind her back. I'll tell her this myself.
choices.description_zh: 开启三人关系的明确讨论；尚未确立双恋，三人将分别表达意愿。
choices.description_en: Open the explicit three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

choices.label_zh: 我不会背着她答应你。我们各自跟她说清楚。
choices.label_en: I won't promise you anything behind her back. We'll each speak to her ourselves.
choices.description_zh: 继续三人讨论；尚未提交双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

scenes.title_en: She Wants to Hear It From You

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 莉迪亚说，她喜欢我。我也喜欢她。我不想骗你说只把她当朋友，这件事得我自己告诉你。
lines.en: Lydia says she likes me. I like her too. I don't want to lie and say she's just a friend. I had to tell you myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……然后呢？你还真敢当着我的面说！
lines.en: ...And then? You really dare say it to my face!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我当然生气！……我早就觉得不对劲了。她不来，你也不提。我还以为是我自己多心。
lines.en: Of course I'm angry! ...I've felt something was off for a while. She didn't come, and you didn't mention her. I thought I was imagining things.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我一问起她，你就岔开话——你也知道早该说！
lines.en: Whenever I asked about her, you changed the subject. You knew you should have told me earlier!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你现在想怎么样？跟我分开？
lines.en: So what do you want now? To break up with me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我想跟你在一起。可也喜欢上了她。这两句话，我都得当面说。
lines.en: I want to be with you. And I have fallen for her too. I owe you both truths, to your face.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你倒是坦白。她呢？她怎么说？
lines.en: ...You're honest, at least. What about her? What did she say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说会自己去找你。
lines.en: She said she'd come find you herself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她找我？
lines.en: She'll find me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前两天我还在想，她要是再也不来了，是不是就能当作什么都没发生。后来我自己想去找她。想问她到底在躲什么……又怕她真说出来。
lines.en: A couple of days ago I was still thinking that if she never came again, maybe I could pretend none of it happened. Then I wanted to go find her myself. To ask what she was hiding... and afraid she'd actually tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那天三个人吃饭，她拿块面包学别人挑货，我笑得差点把水洒了。后来她回来拿披肩，我还想叫她坐下。
lines.en: At dinner she held up that bread and imitated a customer. I nearly spilled my water laughing. When she came back for her shawl, I wanted to ask her to sit down again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我也想过，往后还这样一起过晚上。我想要你，也想她留下。……可你别以为，我这就不吃醋了。
lines.en: I have imagined more evenings together like that. I want you, and I want her to stay too. ...Do not think that means I have stopped being jealous.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等你们谈过，我还在这儿。
lines.en: After you two talk, I'll still be here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先让我跟她谈。我有话要问她，你替不了。
lines.en: Let me talk to her first. I have questions for her that you can't answer for me.

blocks.label_en: One: Wait for Them to Talk

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天你别突然不找我。别以为我生气了，你就该躲远点。
lines.en: Don't suddenly stop coming to see me these next few days. Don't think that because I'm angry, you should stay away.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天照常开门。你来，就能见到我。
lines.en: I'll open as usual tomorrow. If you come, you'll see me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: ...Hmph.

choices.label_zh: 好。等你们谈完。你想问我什么，我都答。
choices.label_en: All right. After you two talk. Whatever you want to ask me, I'll answer.
choices.description_zh: 继续共同关系讨论，尚未登记双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the joint discussion; the relationship is not registered yet.

choices.label_zh: 我会把答应你们的事做到。
choices.label_en: I will keep my promises to both of you.
choices.description_zh: 明确承担这段关系，继续三方讨论。
choices.description_en: Take responsibility and continue the three-way discussion.

scenes.title_zh: 你教我的话，自己也听一遍
scenes.title_en: Listen to the Line You Taught Me

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我去找她了。……不对，是她先来找的我。
lines.en: I went to find her. ...No, she came to find me first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她一进门就问：“你不是说过，喜欢一个人就别总让他猜吗？”那是我教她的话！她拿来堵我的嘴。
lines.en: The moment she walked in she asked, 'Didn't you say if you like someone, don't make them guess?' That's what I taught her! She used it to shut me up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说那是说她。她说：“轮到你，就不算数了？”
lines.en: I said that was about her. She said: 'So it doesn't count when it's your turn?'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说，她要是不想再看见我，我以后就不……话没说完，她就打断我：“你看，又替我把话答了。”
lines.en: I said if she didn't want to see me again, I just wouldn't—before I finished, she cut in: 'See? Answering for me again.'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前看你们死活不肯开口，我恨不得替你们说。轮到自己，连第一句该从哪儿说起都不知道。
lines.en: I used to watch you two refuse to open your mouths and want to say it for you. Now it's my turn, and I don't even know where to start.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 后来她问我到底想要什么。我说，我想见你。不是把你送到门口，自己站在外面等。
lines.en: Then she asked what I actually wanted. I said I wanted to see you. Not to walk you to the door and stand outside waiting.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说，她也想我们三个还像那天，说着话就忘了时间。她不会一下子就不介意，也不会每回都把约好的晚上让给我。
lines.en: She said she wants the three of us to be like that day again, talking until we lose track of time. She won't stop minding all at once, and she won't give me every agreed evening either.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说那就各自约。一起去挑东西时，她得陪我逛完，别总惦记着回来见你。
lines.en: I said we'd make separate plans. When we go shopping together, she has to finish the trip with me. Don't keep thinking about coming back to see you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 然后我们俩都哭了。……她不承认，你别问她。
lines.en: Then we both cried. ...She won't admit it. Don't ask her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说下回跟我一起来。我连穿什么都想好了，话却还在脑子里打架。
lines.en: She said she'd come with me next time. I've already thought about what to wear, but the words are still fighting in my head.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我先说一句最要紧的。我想跟你在一起。
lines.en: Then I will say the most important bit first. I want to be with you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也是。
lines.en: So do I.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那下回就轮到你了。想清楚再说，别到时候只会一句“都行”。
lines.en: Then it'll be your turn next time. Think before you speak. Don't just sit there saying, 'Whatever you want.'

scenes.title_en: All Three of Us, Saying Everything

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟你说我哭了，是吧？她先哭的。
lines.en: She told you I cried, didn't she? She cried first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 手帕明明是我先拿出来的！……算了，今天不跟你争这个。
lines.en: I was the one who got out a handkerchief first! ...Oh, never mind. We can argue about that later.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想好了。我们三个一起试试。先说好，我吃醋会直接告诉你，别指望我突然变大方。
lines.en: I have thought it over. I want to try this, the three of us. And I will tell you when I am jealous. Do not expect sudden generosity.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你约我的时候，也不许只顾着看她。
lines.en: And when you ask me out, you cannot spend the whole time looking at her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我愿意。……手给我。
lines.en: I want this. ...Give me your hand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也愿意。这回别把我落在门口了。
lines.en: I'm willing too. This time don't leave me at the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来只是来帮个小忙的。
lines.en: I only came to help out a little.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 帮得可真够彻底。
lines.en: You certainly helped thoroughly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我要收介绍费。一个吻……别当着整家店的面。
lines.en: Then I'm charging a referral fee. One kiss... not in front of the whole shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就不能慢一点？
lines.en: Can't you slow down?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个嘛，以后你可以教我。
lines.en: Well, you can teach me that later.

choices.label_zh: 如果你们也都愿意，那从今天起，我们三个人认真走下去。
choices.label_en: If you're both willing too, then starting today, let's be serious about this—all three of us.
choices.description_zh: 双方明确同意后提交双恋；不收取任何费用。
choices.description_en: Commit the dual relationship after both explicit agreements; no fee.

scenes.title_en: She Finally Doesn't Need an Excuse

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 忙完没有？我挑了半天衣服，你就看这一眼？
lines.en: Finished yet? I spent ages choosing what to wear, and that is all the attention I get?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……今天想让我陪你多久？
lines.en: ...How long do you want me to stay today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想你了。
lines.en: I missed you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天要去哪儿？已经到了。
lines.en: Where are we going today? We're already here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯，专门为这儿挑的。先挑了一条，太像去见长辈；换了这条，又舍不得那条的颜色，在镜子前转了好几圈。
lines.en: Mm. I picked it for this place. I tried one on first, but it looked too much like meeting a relative. Then I changed to this one and couldn't give up the color of the other. I turned in front of the mirror for ages.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挑得很好。现在不用教了。
lines.en: You chose well. You don't need lessons now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前教你夸她，没觉得一句话这么难接。……那你多看一会儿，又不是只给你看进门那一眼。
lines.en: When I was teaching you to compliment her, I never thought one sentence could be so hard to answer. ...Then look a little longer. It's not just for the glance at the door.

blocks.label_en: Replacement Middle Section Without the New Portrait

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 出门前照了好一会儿镜子。你再不说话，我可要自己夸了。
lines.en: I spent a long time in front of the mirror. If you say nothing, I shall have to compliment myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看见了。今天很好看。
lines.en: I see. You look beautiful today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我还以为得我提醒你呢。
lines.en: ...I thought I'd have to remind you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……再亲一下。
lines.en: ...Kiss me again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……原来真到了这时候，我也没那么会说话。
lines.en: ...So when it actually happens, I'm not that good with words after all.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还记得我替首饰店摆的展柜吗？老板又找我了，这回我想换个摆法。
lines.en: Do you remember the display I arranged for the jewelry shop? The owner came to me again. I want to try a different layout this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你跟她也约好了，我知道。今天别老看时间，弄得我随时又要先走。
lines.en: You've made plans with her too. I know. Don't keep checking the time today and making me feel I'll have to leave first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天的时间是你的。
lines.en: Today's time is yours.

choices.label_en: Come here. Let me hold you for a while.
Sit closer. Let's take our time talking today.

scenes.title_en: She Didn't Give Up Her Place

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天是我们约好的。我就想听你说一遍。
lines.en: Today is our agreed time. I just want to hear you say it once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工作顺。上面的人都知道我哪天要早走。我跟他们说了，是来见你，不是偷偷摸摸来的。
lines.en: Work's fine. Everyone upstairs knows which day I leave early. I told them I'm coming to see you, not sneaking around.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……上回是她来陪你的吧。我不问待到几点。有一点吃醋！你别笑，我就是想知道。
lines.en: ...Last time it was her turn to keep you company, right? I won't ask how long. I'm a little jealous! Don't laugh. I just want to know.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你别一见我，就把跟她说过的话全交代一遍，听得我像个来查账的。
lines.en: Don't recite everything you said to her the moment you see me. It makes me feel like I'm here to audit the books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天就想说一件事——我从上面回来，第一个想见的还是你。别以为多了一个人，我就会少要一点。
lines.en: I only want to say one thing today—when I come back from upstairs, the first person I want to see is still you. Don't think one more person means I'll ask for less.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没打算让你少要。
lines.en: I wasn't planning to ask you to.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就抱紧一点。
lines.en: Then hold me tighter.

scenes.title_zh: 今天不用替我们腾地方
scenes.title_en: You Don't Have to Make Room for Us Today

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天你别再说“随便吃点”。
lines.en: Don't say 'let's just eat something' today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不商量好，总有人忙到最后，拿冷饭当晚饭。
lines.en: If we don't plan it, someone always ends up busy until the food's cold and calls it dinner.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说的是你，也是她自己。
lines.en: She means you, and herself too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你现在连我的话都替我补全了？
lines.en: Now you're finishing my sentences for me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你以前补得比我多。
lines.en: You used to finish mine more than I do yours.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就先——
lines.en: Then I'll just—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下。今天不用替我们腾地方。
lines.en: Sit down. You don't have to make room for us today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又没说要走。只是……上回坐在这儿，到这时候，就该我找借口了。
lines.en: I didn't say I was leaving. It's just... last time I sat here, at this point I'd be finding an excuse.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回不用找。你那份也留着呢。
lines.en: You don't need one this time. Your portion is still here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那我不走了。点心还没吃呢。
lines.en: ...Then I won't go. We haven't had the pastries yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这点心，不是专门给我们买的吧？
lines.en: This dessert wasn't bought especially for us, was it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 本来是。今天我也想吃。我本来就会直说，只有喜欢你这件事，练得久了一点。
lines.en: It was at first. Today I wanted some too. I'm usually direct. Only liking you took a little practice.

blocks.label_en: After Dinner, If the Plaque Is Still in the Showcase

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 牌子还摆着呢。生意怎么样，我早就说了，还得看你自己。
lines.en: The plaque is still up. Business, like I said, depends on you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你今天来检查生意？
lines.en: So are you here to inspect the business today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不查。我想见的人，两个都在。
lines.en: Not today. Both the people I wanted to see are here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 都坐近一点。我可不想隔着桌子看你们。
lines.en: Both of you sit closer. I don't want to look at you across the table.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说得好！往这边挪，我还给你留了点心。
lines.en: Gladly! Move this way. I saved you some dessert.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你再挪，我这边都没地方了。
lines.en: Any closer and there will be no room left on my side.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还好意思说我？
lines.en: And you have the nerve to say that about me?

blocks.label_en: Plaque Not Displayed or Not Collected

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 给我也尝一口你的。她那份奶油比我的还多。
lines.en: Let me try yours too. Hers has even more cream than mine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 挑了半天，还是惦记别人的。
lines.en: All that choosing, and you still want someone else's.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你刚才还夹走他碗里的菜呢！
lines.en: You just took something from his bowl!

scenes.title_en: The Two of Them Together

blocks.label_en: Daily 1: The Two of Them Together

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 帮我看看，这条披肩配裙子，还是上一条好？
lines.en: Help me choose. Does this shawl suit the dress, or was the other one better?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你一路问了我三遍。
lines.en: You asked me three times on the way here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以才来问他呀。来，先别看账。
lines.en: Which is why I am asking him! Come on, leave the accounts a moment.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这条。……你也换了？都好看，站近点。
lines.en: This one. ...You changed too? Both look good. Stand closer.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。站近点就站近点。
lines.en: Mm. Closer it is.

scenes.title_en: Lydia Alone

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今晚席上又有人夸你了，说买回去的旧摆钟，比她家那座新钟还准。
lines.en: Someone praised you at dinner tonight. She said the old clock she bought here kept better time than her new one.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你是不是又想问，我有没有说是我先找着这家店的？我忙着高兴，哪还记得！
lines.en: Are you going to ask again whether I told people I found this shop first? I was too busy being happy to remember!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那多陪我一会儿。也算替我庆祝。
lines.en: Then stay with me a little longer. Call it celebrating for me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好啊。不过先给你看看，我今天戴的这只耳夹。
lines.en: Gladly. But first, have a look at these earrings.

scenes.title_en: Eleanor Alone

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她让我带句话，说她晚点再来。
lines.en: She asked me to tell you she'll come later.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在这会儿，是我的。后半句是我说的，不许删。
lines.en: Right now is mine. The second half was my addition. Don't cut it.

scenes.title_en: Separate Plans

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天我们俩出去，你自己记得吃饭。
lines.en: The two of us are going out tomorrow. Remember to eat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回是谁嫌我们挑东西挑太久？这回不带你了。
lines.en: Who complained last time that we took too long shopping? You're not coming this time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那带点好吃的回来。
lines.en: Then bring back something good to eat.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个好办！
lines.en: That's easy!

scenes.title_en: In the Window and in the Shop

blocks.label_en: Daily 5: In the Window and in the Shop

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 刚才有人在外面盯着我的名字看。没进来，先问我是不是本人。
lines.en: Someone outside was staring at my name earlier. They didn't come in. First they asked whether I was really me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么说？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说是，然后让他看货，别光盯着我看。
lines.en: I said yes, then told him to look at the goods, not just at me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 越来越会做生意了。
lines.en: You're getting better at business.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我坐会儿，你忙你的——不过这只耳夹，我都戴一路了，你还没看见？
lines.en: Then I'll sit a while. You do your work—but I've been wearing this ear clip the whole way here. You haven't noticed?

scenes.title_en: The Reason to Come Back

blocks.label_en: Daily 6: The Reason to Come Back

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在上面讲你这儿的东西，讲得比讲自己新买的裙子还多。
lines.en: Upstairs, she talks about the things in your shop more than she talks about the new dresses she buys.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是因为有人问！
lines.en: That's because people ask!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没人问的时候呢？
lines.en: And when no one asks?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……也讲一点。你还不是一样，说是下来卖东西，坐下就不想走。
lines.en: ...I still talk about them a little. You're the same—you say you're coming down to sell goods, then you sit down and don't want to leave.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天都不急。
lines.en: No rush today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 知道。别的事我都办完了。
lines.en: I know. I've finished everything else.

scenes.title_en: One Item, Two Opinions

blocks.label_zh: 日常七：一件东西，两种意见

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这摆件的颜色，也太热闹了吧？金漆还配红花。
lines.en: Those colors are rather lively, are they not? Gold paint and red flowers!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 放在货里一眼就看得见，说不定好卖。
lines.en: It catches your eye among the stock. It might sell well.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好卖就得夸好看？这句我可说不出口。
lines.en: Must I call it pretty because it sells? I refuse.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你说摆在哪儿。你上回那个展柜，我可听人夸过。
lines.en: Then tell me where to put it. I heard good things about your last display.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还真比挤在一堆里顺眼。
lines.en: It does look better than when it was crammed in with everything else.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 当然！东西俗一点，摆得可不能也俗。
lines.en: Of course! A gaudy ornament does not need a gaudy display.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们两个的事，我听她说过了，不是来让你重说一遍的。
lines.en: I've heard about you two from her. I'm not here to make you repeat it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不过有件事，我想亲口问你。
lines.en: But there's one thing I want to ask you myself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她们听我提了几回，都说愿意来看看，还让我带路。我说我亲自看过货，眼光总信得过。她们这才肯往下面走一趟。
lines.en: They heard me mention you a few times and said they'd like to come see the place. They even asked me to show them the way. I said I'd inspected the goods myself, so my judgment should be worth trusting. That's what got them to come down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 摆橱窗里，别压账本底下。认识我的人看见，就知道没走错门。
lines.en: Put it in the showcase. Do not bury it under your ledger. People who know me will know they have the right door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人进来以后，看你的本事。我可没答应替你卖。
lines.en: Once customers are inside, that's your part. I never promised to sell for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回聚会，她们反过来夸你，说你挑旧货的眼光比上面几家店都准。我差点抢着说，是我先找着你的。
lines.en: At the last gathering they praised you back, saying your eye for old goods is sharper than several shops upstairs. I almost blurted out that I found you first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 先收这个。她们再来挑东西，可就不只带零钱。以前总是我说你好，现在倒轮到我坐在那儿听。……还挺高兴的。
lines.en: Take this first. Next time they come shopping, they won't just bring pocket money. I used to be the one telling them you were good. Now I'm the one sitting there listening. ...I'm happy about it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天竟有人托我，问能不能替她约你看货。以前都是我拉着她们来，现在得先问你哪天有空。
lines.en: Today someone actually asked me to arrange a viewing with you for her. Before, I was the one dragging them here. Now I have to ask which day you're free.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你要来，我总会留时间。
lines.en: There is always time for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我说的是客人。这个也给你，摆橱窗里。碰上满意的客人，她们也愿意多留谢意。
lines.en: ...I mean for customers. This one's for you too. Put it in the display. Satisfied customers are more willing to leave a token of thanks.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真好。以后不用绞尽脑汁，想该带谁来捧场了。
lines.en: Good. No more racking my brain over who to bring to fill the place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回替你收着的东西，我带来了。看看这次放得下没有。
lines.en: I brought what I was keeping for you. See if you have room this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 牌子摆不摆，你自己决定。我可没打算天天站门口数客人。
lines.en: Whether you put that plaque out is up to you. I am not standing outside counting customers every day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天也不是来查账的——我有件自己的事。
lines.en: I'm not here to audit the accounts today either. I have something of my own.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 快告诉我，上回那顿饭，后来吃得怎么样？
lines.en: Tell me—how did the rest of that dinner go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工作的事还是照先前说的办。别每回见我，都像我要重新去应聘一样。
lines.en: Work is going as we discussed. You do not have to look at me as if I am applying all over again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先前没说清的那件事，今天说清吧。我不想再让我们两个猜了。
lines.en: Let us settle what we left unsaid. I do not want either of us to keep guessing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天真是路过。我在隔壁看了一枚胸针，标价倒比东西还精神。
lines.en: I really was passing by today. I saw a brooch next door with a price rather more impressive than the brooch.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 来问你：石头松了，修好以后值不值得买？
lines.en: I came to ask you: the stone's loose. Is it worth buying after repairs?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先算修理的钱。喜欢也别替卖家付两遍。
lines.en: Count the repair cost first. Liking it is no reason to pay the seller twice.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这话能听。那我先不急着买了。
lines.en: That makes sense. Then I won't rush to buy it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺问，你最近是不是又忙得没吃午饭。
lines.en: Eleanor wants to know whether you have been too busy to eat lunch again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她自己也忙，才让我跑这趟。你以为替你们传话不用走路？
lines.en: She's busy too. That's why she sent me. You think walking over to pass messages is free?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 替我跟她说，我吃过了。
lines.en: Tell her I have eaten.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真吃过再说。她下回问我你吃的什么，我可编不出来。
lines.en: Tell me that after you've actually eaten. If she asks what you had next time, I can't make it up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我妈今天又问起你。问你店里忙不忙，饭有没有按时吃。她现在倒替你操起心来了。
lines.en: My mother asked about you again today. Whether the shop's busy, whether you're eating on time. Now she's worrying about you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我说我自己来看看。……你先忙，我又没说非要你陪我。
lines.en: I said I'd come and see for myself. ...Go on with your work. I never said you had to entertain me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们约饭别再挑她工作最忙的时候。她嘴上不说，回去连鞋都懒得脱。
lines.en: Don't schedule meals when she's busiest at work. She won't say it, but she goes home too tired to take off her shoes.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不是替她管你。下回先问她。也别拿最贵的店证明你记住了，找个能坐着吃完的地方。
lines.en: I'm not managing you for her. Next time ask her first. And don't prove you remembered by picking the most expensive place. Find somewhere you can sit and finish the meal.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 记住就行。
lines.en: Just remember that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这件首饰，我最后还是没买。试了三次，每次都想问别人好不好看。后来一想，我自己都没那么喜欢。
lines.en: I didn't buy that piece in the end. I tried it three times, and every time I wanted to ask someone whether it looked good. Then I thought, I didn't even like it that much.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这回没替谁挑。我自己的东西，总得让我自己点头。
lines.en: This time I didn't pick it for anyone else. My own things have to get my own approval.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺说，店里这阵子还不错。
lines.en: Eleanor says business has been decent lately.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你先忙。我今天没有要你当场回答的问题。
lines.en: Then carry on. I have no question you need to answer on the spot today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐一会儿也行。
lines.en: You can sit for a while.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那就一会儿。别以为我要替你看店。
lines.en: ...Just a little while. Do not expect me to watch the shop.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行，我先替你收着。准备好了就跟我说，别到时候又不好意思开口。
lines.en: Fine, I'll keep it for you. Tell me when you're ready. Don't get shy about asking when the time comes.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我收货的时候，什么时候不好意思过？
lines.en: When have I ever been shy about taking in goods?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……这倒也是。
lines.en: ...Fair point.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不是不想说。是想好了再说。
lines.en: It's not that I don't want to say it. I want to say it once I've thought it through.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你想好了，自己来跟我说。别再让莉迪亚替你传话。
lines.en: Then when you've thought it through, come tell me yourself. Don't have Lydia pass messages for you again.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，还有件正事。有人托我问，你这儿有没有小一点的净水器，能随身带的那种，不是摆在屋里的。
lines.en: Oh, right, there's actual business. Someone asked me to find out if you have a smaller water purifier—the kind you can carry, not one that stays in a room.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 多小？拿去干什么？
lines.en: How small? What's it for?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 要下来下层区看场地，不想一路拎着水。她自己挑的那个倒是漂亮，外壳亮得能照人。
lines.en: She's coming down to the Lower Level to look at a site and doesn't want to carry water the whole way. The one she picked is pretty enough—the casing is so shiny you can see your reflection.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能用多久，她问了吗？
lines.en: Did she ask how long it lasts?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……还没。我也是先看的颜色。
lines.en: ...Not yet. I looked at the color first too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先问她要用多久、一次带多少水。别先替她买个好看的壳。
lines.en: Ask how long she needs it to last and how much water she carries at a time. Don't buy her a pretty shell first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺也这么说！她还让我转告你，别忘了看剩下的耐久。
lines.en: That's what Eleanor said too! She told me to remind you not to forget the remaining durability.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说得对。
lines.en: She's right.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又没说她不对。就是你们俩现在连挑东西都像串通好了。
lines.en: I didn't say she was wrong. It's just that you two even shop like you've conspired together.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她低头翻包，拿出一张记着要求的纸，纸角折得整整齐齐。*
lines.en: *She looks through her bag and takes out a sheet of paper with the requirements written down, its corners neatly folded.*

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你记的这些有用。来买东西的人，不会只说一句“要最耐用的”。
lines.en: What you've written down is useful. People who come to buy don't just say 'the most durable one.'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。她还说别太沉，握着要顺手。这个我也记了。
lines.en: Mm. She also said it shouldn't be too heavy and should feel comfortable in the hand. I wrote that down too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就照这个找。
lines.en: Then I'll look for that.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好。我只跟她说你肯看这笔生意，别的让她自己来问。
lines.en: Good. I'll only tell her you're willing to look at the deal. She can ask the rest herself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回不替我打包票了？
lines.en: Not vouching for me this time?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 学乖了！你们俩用不着轮流提醒我。
lines.en: I've learned! You two don't need to remind me in turns.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我先不跟她说。你有了货再找我——直接找她也行。
lines.en: Then I won't tell her yet. Find me when you have the stock—or just find her directly.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 找你方便。你常来。
lines.en: Finding you is easier. You come often.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你倒是说得理所当然。
lines.en: ...You say that like it's a given.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那个净水器，她带出门用了。回来先跟我说轻，又说没买错。
lines.en: She took that water purifier out with her. When she got back, she told me first how light it was, then that she'd bought the right one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回没光看外壳。
lines.en: This time she didn't just look at the casing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她还问起你这儿别的东西。我让她下回自己来，别什么都让我在中间传。
lines.en: She even asked about other things you have. I told her to come herself next time, instead of making me pass everything along.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嫌麻烦了？
lines.en: Tired of the hassle?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……也不是。就是我想来的时候，不想先等着谁有东西要买。
lines.en: ...Not exactly. It's just that when I want to come, I don't want to have to wait until someone needs to buy something.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回那件东西，她后来在别处找到了。你不用一直记着欠我一笔生意。
lines.en: She found that item somewhere else afterward. You don't have to keep thinking you owe me a sale.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没记账。
lines.en: I wasn't keeping score.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就好。以后有合适的，照常谈。
lines.en: Good. If something suitable comes up, we'll talk as usual.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天没生意，也照常坐。

lines.text: ……我这不是还没起身嘛。

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟莉迪亚说了，改天好好请她吃顿饭。上回她跑得比谁都快。
lines.en: I told Lydia we should treat her to a proper meal one of these days. Last time she ran off faster than anyone.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回让她别跑。
lines.en: Tell her not to run this time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯，我跟她说。……不过她最近有点怪。
lines.en: Mm, I'll tell her. ...Though she's been a little strange lately.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 橱窗里的名字，会让路过的人停下来看一眼。可真进了门，他们问的是东西，谈的是价钱。到了饭桌边，莉迪亚不用再替那块牌子说话，埃莉诺也不用再替她解释。
lines.en: The name in the showcase makes passersby stop and look. But once they come inside, they ask about goods and talk about prices. At the dinner table, Lydia no longer has to speak for the plaque, and Eleanor no longer has to explain for her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她以前老说，回上面找个熟人，总比在下面求人强。
lines.en: She used to say going back upstairs to find someone she knew was always better than begging for help down here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在呢？
lines.en: And now?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在会先问我要她帮什么了。问完，还是忍不住添两句自己的主意。
lines.en: Now she asks what I need help with first. After that, she still can't resist adding a couple of ideas of her own.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你让她添？
lines.en: You let her?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让啊。她有时候说得也对，我又不是只会跟她吵。
lines.en: I do. Sometimes she's right. It's not like all I do is argue with her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她今天是不是又没怎么吃东西？我想拉她去以前常去的那家，她说没胃口。
lines.en: She barely ate again today, didn't she? I wanted to take her to that place we used to go, but she said she had no appetite.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她现在心里只有她母亲。
lines.en: Her mother is all she can think about right now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道。一开始我还以为，陪她买点东西、逗她笑一笑就好了。现在才明白，有些事不是我多说几句就能过去的。
lines.en: I know. At first I thought buying her a few things and making her laugh would be enough. I understand now that some things won't pass just because I talk more.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别逼她高兴。问问她今天缺什么。
lines.en: Don't force her to be happy. Ask what she needs today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。这回我先听她说。
lines.en: Mm. This time I'll listen to her first.

retiredBlocks.label_zh: 共同第21章：正常探望，先说朋友
retiredBlocks.label_en: Common Chapter 21: A Normal Visit, Friendship First

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来挑了个特别漂亮的摆件。埃莉诺一看，就问这东西能不能烧水。
lines.en: I picked out a really beautiful ornament. Eleanor took one look and asked whether it could boil water.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么说？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不能啊！我还想说好看也算有用。后来她把要买的东西写给我，我才发现她那儿缺的东西还真不少。
lines.en: It can't! I was going to say looking good counts as useful too. Then she wrote down what she needed, and I realized she was missing quite a lot.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以换了？
lines.en: So you changed it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 换了。她挑结实的，我在结实的里头挑最好看的。总不能连这点都不让我管吧。
lines.en: I changed it. She picks the sturdy ones, and I pick the best-looking among the sturdy ones. She can't stop me from having at least that much say.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她怎么说？
lines.en: What did she say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说我总算把聪明用对了地方。……从她嘴里出来的夸奖，就是这个样子。
lines.en: She said I'd finally put my brains to good use. ...That's what praise sounds like from her.

retiredBlocks.label_zh: 普通恋人，未进入本扩展
retiredBlocks.label_en: Ordinary Lovers, Did Not Enter This Expansion

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她告诉我，你们在一起了。
lines.en: She told me you two are together.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你看起来一点都不意外。
lines.en: You don't look surprised at all.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她以前看上一件衣服，嘴上会先嫌袖口不好看。现在说起你，也是先挑三件毛病，再说今天还想下来。
lines.en: When she used to like a dress, she'd start by complaining the cuffs looked wrong. Now when she talks about you, she lists three faults first, then says she wants to come down again today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你当面跟她说了？
lines.en: Did you say that to her face?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说了。她差点把手里的发夹塞我嘴里。
lines.en: I did. She nearly stuffed her hair clip in my mouth.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好好过吧。她来抱怨，我听着；你们的恋爱，我可不替你们谈。
lines.en: Live well together. If she comes to complain, I'll listen. But I'm not handling your romance for you.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说你们把话说开了，以后还是朋友。
lines.en: She said you two talked it out and will stay friends.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就不瞎猜了。以前我总觉得，见得多了、肯帮忙了，就该往那个方向走。
lines.en: Then I'll stop guessing. I used to think that if we saw enough of each other and I was willing to help, it had to lead in that direction.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 也可以只是朋友。
lines.en: It can also just be friendship.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 知道了。这个故事的结局，轮不到我来写。
lines.en: I know. It's not my turn to write the ending of this story.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: superseded by shared core facts or reputation checkpoints

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后看到合适的东西，我还会来问价。这回先看东西，再听故事。
lines.en: If I see something suitable in the future, I'll still come ask the price. This time I'll look at the item first and hear the story second.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 价钱不合适，也可以不买。
lines.en: If the price doesn't suit you, you can walk away.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这还用你教？我就是看到漂亮的，会多犹豫一会儿。
lines.en: Do you need to teach me that? I just hesitate a little longer when something's pretty.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她真那么叫你？
lines.en: She really calls you that?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她告诉你的？
lines.en: Did she tell you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说漏嘴了。我追着问，她就岔开话，最后还怪我笑得太明显。
lines.en: She let it slip. I kept asking, she changed the subject, and then she blamed me for smiling too obviously.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你笑了？
lines.en: You smiled?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一点点。……好吧，不止一点。认识她这么多年，我还没听她把这种话说得这么认真。
lines.en: A little. ...All right, more than a little. I've known her all these years, and I've never heard her say something like that so seriously.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我没跟别人说。她肯告诉我，我就替她守着。
lines.en: I haven't told anyone. If she trusts me with it, I'll keep it for her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚在熟悉的店里替我问过。人家说可以先留个位置，具体做什么以后再说。她一听有机会，高兴得当天就跑来找我。
lines.en: Lydia asked at a shop she knows, on my behalf. They said they could hold a position for now and decide the details later. The moment she heard there was an opening, she was so happy she ran to find me that same day.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你问清楚了？
lines.en: Did you ask for details?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 问了，她也陪我去问的。后来她才明白，我不是非要跟她的好意作对——我得知道自己进去了能干什么。
lines.en: I did, and she came with me to ask. That was when she understood I wasn't trying to oppose her goodwill—I need to know what I'll actually be doing there.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就找肯让你干活的地方。
lines.en: Then find a place that will let you do real work.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。她说下回先问清楚，不拿一句“都可以”当好消息。
lines.en: Mm. She said next time she'll ask clearly first, and not treat 'anything works' as good news.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她今天没问你有没有注意到她的新衣服。进门以后，她先把小包放稳，才开口。*
lines.en: *She doesn't ask whether you noticed her new clothes today. After coming in, she sets her small bag down carefully before speaking.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我去看过她了。想了好多话，坐下来一句都没说出来。
lines.en: I went to see her. I thought of so many things to say, and once I sat down, I couldn't say a single one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 陪着就好。
lines.en: Just being there is enough.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。后来她让我递一样东西给她，我才知道手该往哪儿放。
lines.en: Mm. Later she asked me to hand her something, and only then did I know what to do with my hands.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说以后有自己的打算。要是以前，我肯定先劝她别去。现在……我想先听她把话说完。
lines.en: She says she has her own plans for the future. Before, I definitely would've tried to talk her out of it first. Now... I want to hear her out first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这里就是埃莉诺天天挂在嘴边的那家店？
lines.en: So this is the shop Eleanor never stops talking about?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她今天没来。
lines.en: She's not here today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道。我就是挑她不在的时候来的。
lines.en: I know. I picked a time when she wouldn't be here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 买还是卖？

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 卖。*把一只镯子放上柜台* 价钱我开，你看着收。
lines.en: Selling. *sets a bracelet on the counter* I'll name a price. You decide what you're willing to pay.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说你眼睛毒。我倒想看看有多毒。
lines.en: She says you have a sharp eye. I'd like to see how sharp.

retiredBlocks.label_en: She Isn't in a Hurry to Leave

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *莉迪亚说完那几条，没起身，目光落到了橱窗上。*
lines.en: *After saying her piece, Lydia doesn't get up. Her gaze drifts to the showcase.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，你这儿有没有好一点的日用品？护肤的、净水的……别急着说没有，我刚才好像瞥见一件。
lines.en: Oh, right—do you have any decent household goods? Skin care, water purification... Don't rush to say no. I think I caught sight of something just now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 买给谁？先说用途。
lines.en: Who's it for? Tell me the use first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不是我。我认识一位太太，最近老抱怨她常去的那家店什么都捆着卖。她就想要一件，店员非得给她介绍一整套。
lines.en: Not me. I know a lady who keeps complaining that the shop she frequents bundles everything together. She wants one thing, and the clerks insist on showing her a whole set.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这儿可以一件一件谈。
lines.en: Here you can discuss one item at a time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这话她爱听。
lines.en: She'll like hearing that.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: no runtime caller; preserved as historical writing

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这件可以拿给她看。合不合用，见了东西再说。
lines.en: You can show her this one. Whether it suits her, we'll see once she looks at it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你连一句“包她满意”都不肯先说？
lines.en: You won't even say 'I guarantee she'll be satisfied' first?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 人还没来，我替谁满意？
lines.en: She hasn't even come yet. Who am I guaranteeing satisfaction for?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……也对。上面有些店，一听我姓什么，我还没问完，就说一定合适。
lines.en: ...Fair. Some shops upstairs hear my family name and say it's definitely suitable before I've even finished asking.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你家的名头这么好用？
lines.en: Is your family name really that useful?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 认得的人不少。以前我觉得挺方便。后来买回去的东西不合用，拿去退，人家个个都记得是我自己点的头。
lines.en: Plenty of people recognize it. I used to think it was convenient. Then I'd buy something that didn't work, take it back, and every one of them remembered that I was the one who'd nodded.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以这回先问。
lines.en: So this time you ask first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对。而且她是来找你买东西，又不是来找我家。
lines.en: Right. And she's coming to you to buy something, not to my family.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: no runtime caller; preserved as historical writing

retiredBlocks.label_zh: 没有合适库存（替换上段）

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天没有合适的。普通日用品倒是有，别给她介绍错了。
lines.en: Nothing suitable today. I do have ordinary household goods, but don't recommend the wrong thing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就不让她白跑。我认识几家店，偶尔会处理没用过的旧款，下回让人送来，你先看，收不收你定。
lines.en: Then I won't make her come for nothing. I know a few shops that sometimes clear out unused older stock. I'll have some sent over next time. You look first, and you decide whether to take it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 价钱照常谈。
lines.en: We'll discuss the price as usual.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 知道知道。你还没见着货，这句话我都替你说了。
lines.en: I know, I know. You haven't even seen the goods, and I'm already saying it for you.

retiredBlocks.label_en: Together: She Takes Out the Plaque

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她终于打开小包，拿出一块小小的珐琅铭牌。底座擦得锃亮，边上是你在货单上见过的那个花纹，下面另刻着一行名字。*
lines.en: *At last she opens her small bag and takes out a tiny enamel recommendation plaque. Its base is polished bright, the edge bears the pattern you've seen on the shipment manifests, and a name is engraved on its own line below.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个摆进橱窗。别塞到柜台底下。
lines.en: Put this in the showcase. Don't shove it under the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你家的招牌？
lines.en: Your family's sign?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 花纹是家里的，下面那行是我的名字。认识的人看见了，就知道这家店是我莉迪亚肯替它说话的。
lines.en: The pattern is my family's. The line below is my name. Anyone who recognizes it will know this is a shop that I, Lydia, am willing to speak up for.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这么快就决定替我说好话了？
lines.en: Decided to vouch for me that quickly?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又不是今天才认识你。镯子那回……算了，那回是我不对。后来你怎么帮她，我都看着呢。
lines.en: It's not like I met you today. That business with the bracelet... never mind, I was in the wrong that time. I've been watching how you helped her since then.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 帮她，和会不会做生意，是两回事。
lines.en: Helping her and being good at business are two different things.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以我也看你做生意了！刚才不是被你追着问了半天用途？
lines.en: So I've been watching your business too! Didn't you just spend ages asking me what it was for?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *她把牌子往你手边推了推，又伸手把歪了一点的底座扶正。*
lines.en: *She pushes the plaque toward your hand, then reaches out to straighten its slightly crooked base.*

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我能让他们肯进门。进来以后留不留得住，看你自己。
lines.en: I can get them to walk through the door. Whether you can keep them once they're inside is up to you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这个我会。
lines.en: I can do that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就摆出来。我下回来，要从外面就看得见。
lines.en: Then put it out. Next time I come, I want to see it from outside.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: no runtime caller; preserved as historical writing

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你名字都刻上了，总得让人看见。
lines.en: Your name's already engraved on it. It ought to be seen.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……说得好像我把自己押在你这儿了一样。
lines.en: ...You make it sound like I've put myself up as collateral here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 牌子不值一顿饭？
lines.en: Isn't the plaque worth a meal?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 值！等生意做成了，地方我来挑。
lines.en: It is! Once the business works out, I'll pick the place.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: no runtime caller; preserved as historical writing

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说好了啊，埃莉诺来了，你别张嘴就是今天多来了几个客人。
lines.en: We're agreed, all right? When Eleanor comes, don't open your mouth with how many extra customers you had today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚才给我拉生意的是谁？
lines.en: Who was just drumming up business for me?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 生意我帮你拉，话我也教你说了。你好歹记住一半吧！
lines.en: I bring in the business and teach you what to say. At least remember half of it!

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: no runtime caller; preserved as historical writing

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: *来客在橱窗前停了一下，看清牌子上的名字，才推门进来。*
lines.en: *The visitor pauses before the showcase, reads the name on the plaque, and only then pushes the door open.*

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 莉迪亚说，可以来你这儿看看。
lines.en: Lydia said I could come take a look here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想找什么？
lines.en: What are you looking for?

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 她说你一开口准是这句。我想要一件好点的日用品，别为了买一件，被人劝着搬走半个柜子。
lines.en: She said that would be your first question. I want one good household item. I don't want to be talked into clearing out half a cabinet just to buy one thing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挑合适的。买不买，你自己定。
lines.en: Pick what suits you. Whether you buy is your decision.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 那就拿来看看。
lines.en: Then let me see it.

retiredBlocks.retiredReason: v0.5: no runtime caller; preserved as historical writing

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 行，这件我要了。她说你不太会说好听话，看东西倒是很准。
lines.en: All right, I'll take this one. She said you're not much for flattery, but you're accurate about goods.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后半句留着就行。
lines.en: Just keep the second half.

lines.speaker: UpperBuyer
lines.text: 我会转告她的。下回有合适的，我还来。
lines.en: I'll pass that along. If you get something suitable, I'll come again.
